question: In MS Word, which option allows you to copy the selected text or object to the Clipboard while simultaneously removing it from its original location?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cut**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Cut** option allows you to copy the selected text or object to the Clipboard while simultaneously removing it from its original location.
 
• This is different from the **Copy** option, which only copies the text or object to the Clipboard without removing it from its original location.
